definitions.short: a whinnying (through impatience for battle or lust)
definitions.full: H4684. mitshalah [ מִצְהָלָה ] noun feminine neighing ; — plural construct אַבִּירָיוֺ מִצְהֲלוֺת קוֺל Jer 8:16 (|| סוּסָיוֺ נַחְרַת ); suffix מִצְהֲלוֺתַיִךְ 13:27 of idolatrous Judah, under figure of mare desiring stallion (|| זְנוּתֵךְ זִמַּת נִאֻפַיִךְ, ).
